purpose: Replace repeated images across different catalog products

items.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one premium butcher catalog photograph, square 1024x1024, realistic raw fresh edible offal displayed hygienically on off-white unprinted butcher parchment on light warm grey limestone. Soft daylight from upper left, natural moist texture, no blood pools. Fill about 80 percent of the frame, high three-quarter view, sharp product detail, clean commercial photography matching a cream/forest premium meat shop. NO text, logo, watermark, packaging, plates, vegetables, herbs, utensils, collage or graphic labels. One single product photograph. Subject: ONE large whole BEEF LIVER, a broad flat elongated dark mahogany-brown lobe, with the anatomical shape of bovine liver. Lie it diagonally from lower left to upper right, smooth darker glossy convex surface, broad thin edge facing foreground. Show a wide, substantially elongated silhouette with a small separate upper lobe, not three plump rounded chunks. This must look clearly different from a small pork liver with deeply divided lobes and from sliced pale calf liver.
